justification: ktstrade.com.my (Stihl MY national distributor) chainsaw category page loads and lists named model 'Compact Series MS 172'; its asset images/ms172.jpg returns HTTP 200 image/jpeg 78342 bytes, 580x300 (long edge 580 >= 500), depicting a single Stihl petrol chainsaw clearly labelled 'MS 172'; page gives no bar spec for MS172 but a 16in chain & guide bar is the plausible standard fitment (14in not contradicted).

Same KTS Trading chainsaw category page lists named model 'Compact Series MS 162' (entry-level homeowner saw, 4.5 kg); images/ms162.jpg returns HTTP 200 image/jpeg 61845 bytes, 580x300, showing a single compact Stihl saw whose short guide bar is consistent with the stated 14in bar.

Official megaman.com.my LED T BULB PDP quotes model 'YTT100Z1', 30W, Cap E27, dimension Ø100*180 (item-code suffix ZI corresponds to page's digit-one Z1); wp-content/uploads/2020/12/11-1-1.jpg returns HTTP 200 image/jpeg 41742 bytes, 1600x1600, showing the single white T-shape bulb with E27 cap alone, Megaman branded.

esllighting.com.my (authorised Megaman dealer) PDP titled 'MEGAMAN LED Stick Bulb 15W PLC - YTP45B1' quotes YTP45B1, Product Wattage 15W and CCT including Cool White (4000K); cdn1.npcdn.net PNG returns HTTP 200 image/png 196589 bytes, 1000x1000, showing the single stick/PLC-base bulb alone captioned 'LED Stick Bulb PLC 15W' with Megaman branding.
